test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 20 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In September 2024, which bank launched Aditi, a GenAI powered Virtual Relationship Manager that aims to enhance the digital customer service experience?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bank of Baroda**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **AI-Powered Virtual Relationship Manager** – Launched in September 2024, 'Aditi' is a GenAI-powered chatbot designed to enhance customer service digitally.
 
• **Multilingual & 24x7 Availability **– Provides support via chat, audio, and video in multiple languages, improving accessibility for a diverse customer base.
 
• **Enhances Customer Experience** – Offers conversational banking services, helping users with transactions, queries, and banking assistance.
 
• **Part of AI Initiatives** – Alongside 'Aditi', BoB introduced 'GyanSahay.AI', an AI-driven knowledge platform for employees to improve efficiency.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **State Bank of India:**
 
• While SBI is also investing in digital transformation, the specific launch of "Aditi" is associated with HDFC Bank.
 
• SBI has its own digital platforms and customer service initiatives.
 
• SBI has been working on various digital banking solutions.
 
• SBI has large scale digital banking infrastructure.
 
• SBI is the largest public sector bank in India.
 
• **Canara Bank:**
 
• Canara Bank is another major public sector bank that is focusing on digital banking.
 
• However, the "Aditi" GenAI initiative is specifically an HDFC Bank project.
 
• Canara Bank is also working on improving digital customer interactions.
 
• Canara bank has a wide network of branches.
 
• Canara bank is involved in many digital banking programs.
